verdict.rationale: Windmill workflows-as-code support loops with built-in parallelism and checkpointing, so a flow can process many items (windmill-docs-5), and 'branch all' runs multiple branches together (windmill-docs-12). On the workspace side, AI-edited items can be reviewed and deployed together from Compare & Deploy (windmill-docs-21), and Git sync deploys commits into the workspace automatically (windmill-docs-11). These are indirect routes to bulk work, not dedicated bulk-action features. Missing for 10: an explicit for-loop/map-over-items flow step, bulk actions on jobs or runs (e.g. mass cancel or re-run), bulk operations exposed via CLI or MCP, and independent hands-on corroboration.
